 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Surround the source with its reflected/diagonal-reflected copies."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    vertical = [row[:] for row in grid[::-1]]
    horizontal = [row[::-1] for row in grid]
    diagonal = [[grid[r][c] for r in range(h)] for c in range(w)]
    tiles = [
        [diagonal, vertical, diagonal],
        [horizontal, [row[:] for row in grid], horizontal],
        [diagonal, vertical, diagonal],
    ]
    return [
        [value for tile in tile_row for value in tile[r]]
        for tile_row in tiles
        for r in range(h)
    ]
"
}
